sourceEdition: IM K-5 2021 first edition, original optional lesson

source.images: Original garbage truck photo, container drawing, partially/full cargo ship pictures inspected as source reference only, not copied into Edulytiks.
source.curriculumStatus: Optional; original teacher preparation does not introduce a new mathematical content standard, but lists 5.MD.C.5 addressing

comparison.originalWarmup: Notice and Wonder at garbage truck photograph, mass/space context; 3300 tons and 60 containers are contextual quantities, not a volume conversion
comparison.originalTask1: Choose at least FIVE different rectangular arrangements of 60 identical shipping containers; expression and judged visual display for shipping 3,300 tons
comparison.originalTask2: Separate lower/plausible/upper estimates for partially loaded versus fully loaded cargo ship images; written assumptions about stacked rows/layers and occluded deck
comparison.candidate: Existing original Grade-5 Rich V2 L12 sidecar models both tasks using five factor triples, a teacher-reviewed best-arrangement choice, bounds and explicit assumptions. No misleading fixed real-ship count.
comparison.independentArithmetic: (1×6×10)=(2×5×6)=(3×4×5)=(2×3×10)=(1×3×20)=60, five distinct dimension multisets; illustrative 8×12×4=384 only under stated assumptions.
comparison.unresolved: Candidate text/tables do not reproduce source imagery, the student’s original drawn display, particular visual ship estimation, or independent asset licensing; teacher rubric and effective authenticated rendering not verified. 3,300 tons describes mass, not automatically cubic volume.
comparison.gradeOwnedEdit: READY_REUSE, so no redundant rich-sidecar rewriting and no version bump

rubric.correct: Five distinct valid positive-integer arrangements giving 60; reasoned choice with constraints; coherent low/central/high estimates and explicit premises
rubric.reject: Declaring one universally optimal layout, counting mass as volume, claiming 384 ships' actual capacity, wrong products, unjustified guesses
rubric.teacherAssessed: Presentation and spatial sketches, ship suitability, photograph-based estimates and model assumptions
